During [[Operation Shadow Hand]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]<ref name="EE" /> was the commander of [[Green Squadron (New Republic)|Green Squadron]], holding the callsign '''Green Leader'''.<ref name="EEa" /> In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Empire's End 1|''Empire's End'' 1]] to [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]]. Moreover, ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' dates the destruction of the ''Pelagia'' to 10 years after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].</ref> Green Leader and his squadron were located in the [[Ottega system/Legends|Ottega system]], where they were bound to rendezvous with the New Republic [[Troop transport/Legends|troopship]] ''[[Pelagia]]'' in order to join the [[Siege of an Imperial Galactic Rim shipyard|siege]] of an [[Unidentified Imperial shipyard|Imperial Galactic Rim shipyard]].<ref name="EE" />

While Green Squadron was in the process of docking with the ''Pelagia'', a [[particle disintegrator warhead]] was fired by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the ''Pelagia'' from the [[Galaxy Gun]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. Green Leader and his squadron attempted to destroy the missile, but they were unable to penetrate its shields, and the warhead [[Destruction of the Pelagia|destroyed]] the ''Pelagia''.<ref name="EEa" />
